product_metadata.title: The Elixir Deco Premium Extra Large Pop up Hat Storage Box Hat Boxes for Women Storage Hat Box Storage Travel Case Bag Round Hat Containers, Keeps Out Dust and Dirt
features: LOTS OF SPACE HAT STORAGE BOX BAG: It comfortably fit 11 inches worth of stacked hats. Depending on the model and size of the hats this translates to at least 4 to 8 hats.
EASY STORAGE: The Pop Up Hat Storage Bag can be collapsed when not in use and takes up very little space. It can very flexible fit in closet spaces with all kinds of heights, perfect for home use
SIZE: This extra large hat storage container bag is about 11 inches high fully expanded and has a diameter of 17 inches. When compressed it takes up to as little as 1.5 inches in height

QUALITY DESIGN: This collapsible hat storage bag has black color, high-quality zippers and it protects your hats against dust and dirt. It is sturdy and light enough to be used as carry-on luggage for travel.
100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEE: We aim for 100% customer satisfaction
